implementation_summary: Added isLocalOriginHost to safe-net.ts. RobotsPolicy.fetch's default fetch now sets allowPrivate from whether the crawl origin host is local/private, so a local build's own robots.txt is read again. Public origins stay allowPrivate:false. A caller-supplied fetchFn is unchanged. A shared machine (browser guard) still refuses private addresses. Added 3 regression tests.
